//: Committed project hook: TrackPoli turns the enterprise always-on directive on for anyone who works in this repo, with no per-machine install step. The hook runs always-on/emit-directive.mjs (exec form, no shell) via ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}, so a git pull updates both this wiring and the directive content together and every new session is current by construction. Claude Code asks each person once to trust these project hooks (a security prompt, not staleness); after that, content updates apply automatically on pull. See always-on/README.md and .claude/skills/bootstrap/SKILL.md. Requires Node on PATH. If exec form does not run on a machine (Windows), that person can switch their copy to the PowerShell form in always-on/settings.snippet.json.
